title: Using NEPC cell NCI-H660 for _in vitro_ assays
protocol: Prepare complete cell medium using RPMI-1640 base medium with 5% FBS, 10 nM β-estradiol, 10 nM Hydrocortisone, and 1% Insulin-Transferrin-Selenium.
Thaw frozen cells by continuously swirling the vial in a 37 °C water bath until a slight amount of ice remains.
Add thawed cells to 10 ml chilled PBS.
Mix and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 4 minutes.
Resuspend cells in 5 ml complete cell medium by pipetting up and down for 100 times to break cell clusters.
Plate cells in a T-25 cell culture flask.
Place the flask upright for 1 minute to make unattached cells settle down.
Gently remove half of the medium (~ 2 ml) from the upper layer with a 5 ml serological pipette.
Renew the medium.
When numerous cell clusters are floating, split cells at a 1:2 ratio.
Pipette up and down in the flask to collect all cell clusters.
Transfer collected cells to a 15 ml conical tube.
Centrifuge the cells.
Discard the cell medium.
Resuspend cells with 1 ml Trypsin solution, keep at room temperature for 1 minute.
Neutralize Trypsin with 5 ml complete medium.
Centrifuge the cells again.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 2 ml complete medium, pipette up and down with P1000 tips for 100 times to completely break cell clusters.
Add 8 ml of medium, mix well.
Split the mixture into two T-25 flasks.
Prepare cell freezing medium as follows: chilled FBS 90%, DMSO 10%, keep on ice.
Collect all cell clusters.
Centrifuge and resuspend cells with freezing medium.
Transfer cryogenic vials immediately to Mr. Frosty™ Freezing Container and keep in -80 °C freezer for 24 hours.
Transfer cell vials to liquid nitrogen tank.
Prepare assay medium as follows: RPMI-1640 base medium with 5% FBS, 10 nM β-estradiol, 10 nM Hydrocortisone, 1% Insulin-Transferrin-Selenium, and 1% Matrigel.
Pre-treat 12-well plate with 500 μl assay medium per well; keep in the incubator for at least 30 minutes.
Collect cell clusters and dissociate cells as described in step 4 of the cell culture process.
Resuspend cells in 1 ml assay medium, filter through a 20 μm cell strainer.
Mix 10 μl aliquot of filtered cells with 10 μl Trypan blue solution.
Count cell numbers using an automated cell counter.
Calculate living cell density.
Adjust living cell density to 2 x 10^4 cells/ml with assay medium.
Add cells to the pre-treated plates from above step at 500 μl/well in triplicates, achieving a final density of 10^4 cells/well.
Gently renew half of the assay medium per well every 4 days for colony culture.
Culture for 4~6 weeks until colonies are visible.
Remove medium from cell plates.
Add 1 ml of 4% PFA solution to each well to fix cells at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Discard PFA and place the plate upside down to dry it completely.
Add 1 ml of 0.5% crystal violet solution to each well, shake the plate on a gyratory shaker at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Discard crystal violet solution.
Rinse the plate with tap water multiple times until no background staining is visible in the well.
Leave the plate upside down at room temperature to dry it completely.
Count colonies under a microscope or by photographing directly.
Culture cells by renewing half of the medium every 4 days.
Fix cells at appropriate time points, starting from day 1 and collecting plate every 7~10 days for 4 consecutive time points.
Fix and stain cells as per step 5 in the colony formation assay.
Add 250 μl of 10% acetic acid to each well.
Shake the plate on a gyratory shaker at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Measure the O.D. at 572 nm in a microplate reader.
